errors.text: The target FeNiCrMn single crystal is replaced by a CoCrFeNi polycrystalline alloy, introducing different chemistry, stacking-fault energy, and grain-boundary mechanisms.
The proposed experimental strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^-1 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics range of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1.

It predicts increasing yield strength with strain rate and locates insensitivity at high homologous temperature or low rates, whereas the target result is negligible yield-strength sensitivity specifically across 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1 at 10–600 K.

The high-temperature strength plateau of a BCC refractory alloy is incorrectly extrapolated into evidence for strain-rate insensitivity in an FCC alloy; temperature insensitivity does not imply strain-rate insensitivity.

The hypothesis omits the target's vacancy-cluster-assisted nucleation of 1/6<112> Shockley partials, intrinsic/extrinsic stacking faults, crystallographic orientation dependence, and maximum yield stress along <-111>.
